description: This file defines the ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy class, which extends PurgeStrategy and provides methods for purging and modifying records by replacing their field values with formatted substitute values. It is part of a maintenance plugin for OrangeHRM and appears to be used for data purge operations with customizable replacement strategies.

classes.name: ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy
classes.description: A class that implements a purge strategy by replacing field values in entities with formatted replacements.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Fetches entities matching criteria and purges each entity by replacing specified fields.

methods.name: purgeRecord
methods.description: Replaces the values of specified fields in a given entity with formatted values and persists the changes.

methods.name: getReplaceStrategy
methods.description: Instantiates and returns a ValueFormatter based on the provided strategy name.
